literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) report NPDC1 expressed from the pLX304-V5 vector, which appends a V5 tag to the protein C-terminus. NPDC1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein: signal peptide 1–34 (cleaved), extracellular domain 35–185, TM 186–206, intracellular tail 207–325. The C-terminus (residue 325) is therefore intracellular, placing the V5 tag on the cytoplasmic face. The papers use the V5 signal to confirm expression and detect the protein, while alpha-syn PFF binding is measured separately on the extracellular domain — the tag itself is never reported on the cell surface. No ledger line reports any insertion at the mature N-terminus (after residue 34) or anywhere within the extracellular span (35–185). Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular tag insertion, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal V5 tag (pLX304-V5 vector) confirmed expressed in HEK293T cells; NPDC1 C-terminus (residue 325) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
